reviews.text: Great dog trainer couldn’t ask for anything better corrected all issues my dog was giving thank you

My dog and I had such a great experience!! Geraldo, Ralph, and Marco are WONDERFUL dog trainers. They helped me understand my dog's needs and how to work with her for service work. I would definitely recommend Delta Force K-9 for dog training. They have all the resources and certifications needed for all different types of dog training. After my dog graduated of service training, they still provided classes to keep reinforcing my dogs training as well as my own.

Proof that you can teach an old dog new tricks 😅. Mochi is a 5-year old rescue, who had zero manners. It’s not his fault - no one ever taught him! After spending a month with Gerardo, he now knows commands, walks great on leash, doesn’t bark at people, and is less reactive to anything with wheels (possibly some old trauma)
Obviously the training doesn’t end there (this isn’t a miracle), but Gerardo did give him the foundation he needed and we continued the training at home. It’s been a week since I got him back and he’s improved tremendously!
Dogs are very smart, but they do require time, effort, and patience to be taught properly. With a busy schedule, I knew that wasn’t realistic for me, which is why I’m grateful I was introduced to Gerardo. I can’t recommend him enough! He’s very professional and very knowledgeable when it comes to training dogs, and I’m astonished at what he was able to accomplish with Mochi in just one month. THANK YOU! 🙏
Very good place,they trained my dog very well,and treated him good.Definitely recommend!

Big thanks to the Delta Force K9 team, Gerardo, Michele and the rest of the guys are great; the team will tell it to you straight, and that's what most people need, especially for the working breeds.

Our GSD Luna was very scared and skiddish previously, and after boarding her here, she's so much more confident and obedient. They do a great job balancing a very strict training regimen while truly caring and loving the pups. Cannot recommend Delta Force K9 enough.
Our fur baby Max trained with Mr. Gerardo, a super professional and the best! 💯 Highly recommended …

Excellent training service. I took my dog ​​and the change was incredible. They are very professional, responsible, and really know what they're doing. They explained the whole process to me and were always attentive. I was very satisfied with the results. Highly recommended!

Excellent treatment of the owners and their pets during their stay.
The dog was very obedient and followed commands perfectly. Excellent, 1000% recommended!

Thank you Gerry and the Delta Force K-9 team!!!! You have trained our dogs for over 20 years and we wouldn’t have trusted anyone other than you and your team with our Doberman! You taught us how to overcome a behavior issue we thought was impossible. We couldn’t be more thankful and appreciative of you and your team!
We highly recommend anyone looking for a dog trainer to contact Gerry at Delta Force K-9
Jerry is the best most knowledgeable dog trainer.  He loves what he does.  He has trained 3 of my dogs. I have known him for 10 years.  I highly recommend.
Perfectly trained to perform the commands I wanted. Very professional.
The best, thank you for educating and taking care of my little black girl for two long months!

They trained my Belgian Malinois puppy very well. It's a shame I live so far away that I can't continue attending classes, but I'll keep up with the training. Highly recommended for all types of dogs! 👍 …

I highly recommend Delta Force K9. Great job with Ella, which I imagine it wasn’t easy. The place is big, well maintain, very clean.  Thank you, Gerardo, Marcos for your patience. The weekly classes are enjoyable, and great opportunity for Ella to inter-act with other dogs. Keep the good job.

Huge thank you to Delta For K-9 and the amazing work they did with my Xoloitzcuintli Diego. They took a small hurricane of a dog and taught him manners and how to behave and they will certainly be seeing him on Saturday classes! Lovely school and staff and 10/10 experience
Very professional, with good knowledge who do an excellent job with the dogs
